panoramas.title: “Crocodile Bridge”, Jezero Crater rim
panoramas.colour: natural colour (processed to approximate what the eye would see)

position.basis: MMGIS waypoint at the end of the sol 1710 drive; no drive is listed until sol 1756, so the rover was parked there on sol 1717.

panoramas.limitations: The view direction is not georeferenced (no azimuth is published with the mosaic). The level horizon was estimated from the distant flat skyline at 19% of the image height (about ±1°), giving +15.6° to −66.4° of elevation; the sky above the photographed strip is a plain gradient extrapolated from its top rows, not imagery. Black areas are parts of the mosaic NASA left without data.
